question: Which Indian weightlifter won silver in the Tokyo Olympics 2020 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mirabai Chanu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mirabai Chanu** won the **silver medal** in the **Tokyo Olympics 2020** in the **Women's 49 kg weightlifting category.**
 
• She lifted a total of **202 kg** (87 kg in snatch and 115 kg in clean and jerk) to secure her position and bring glory to India.
 
• Chanu's achievement marked India's **first medal** in the **Tokyo Olympics**, giving the country a great start in the international event.
 
• This was a historic moment as she became the **second Indian weightlifter** to win an Olympic medal after **Karnam Malleswari**, who won bronze in **Sydney 2000.**
 
• Her remarkable performance showcased immense **strength, skill, and determination** on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mirabai Chanu:**

 
 
• She hails from **Nongpok Kakching**, a small village in **Manipur, India**.
 
• Born on **August 8, 1994**, she has been a prominent figure in Indian weightlifting.
 
• She has won several international accolades, including a **gold medal** at the **2018 Commonwealth Games** and a silver medal at the **2014 Commonwealth Games.**
 
• She was awarded the **Padma Shri** in **2018** and the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award** in **2018** for her exceptional achievements in sports.
 
 
 
• **Weightlifting in the Olympics:**
 
 
• Weightlifting has been a part of the **modern Olympic Games** since **1896**.
 
• The sport consists of two lifts: **Snatch** and **Clean and Jerk.**
 
• Medals are awarded based on the total weight lifted in both categories.
 
• India's presence in Olympic weightlifting has been marked by extraordinary performances by athletes like **Karnam Malleswari** and **Mirabai Chanu.**
 
 
 
• **Tokyo Olympics 2020:**
 
 
• The Tokyo Olympics were held from **July 23 to August 8, 2021**, after being postponed due to the **COVID-19 pandemic.**
 
• India won a total of **7 medals** in the event, including **1 gold, 2 silver, and 4 bronze medals.**
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** won India's first-ever Olympic gold in athletics (Javelin Throw).
 
 
 
• **Other Indian Weightlifters:**
 
 
• **Sanjita Chanu:** Known for her achievements in the **Commonwealth Games**, she has won gold medals in **2014** and **2018**.
 
• **Gurdeep Singh:** Represents India in the **heavyweight categories** of weightlifting and has participated in several international tournaments.
 
• **Bindyarani Devi:** She is an emerging weightlifter from **Manipur**, with notable performances in national and international events.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Karnam Malleswari:**

 
 
• She was the first Indian woman to win an **Olympic medal** in weightlifting.
 
• She achieved this milestone by winning a **bronze medal** in the **2000 Sydney Olympics.**
